name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension / Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: At every positive recursive-teaching stage, a smallest positive teaching set yields a hollow star after removing its target.
proof: Fix any positive recursive teaching order. At a stage with remaining family $\mathcal G$, target $h$, and a smallest positive teaching set $S$ of size $d$, minimality gives, for each $x\in S$, a concept $g_x\in\mathcal G\setminus\{h\}$ that is one on $S\setminus\{x\}$ and zero at $x$. No remaining competitor is one on all of $S$, by the teaching property. Thus, after deleting $h$ and projecting to $S$, the all-one trace is absent while each of its one-coordinate flips is present: the projected subfamily has co-VC dimension at least $d$. Therefore $\mathrm{coVC}^*(\mathcal H)$ bounds every stage of every positive recursive order, and hence bounds the minimum possible maximum stage size $\mathrm{RTD}^+(\mathcal H)$.
